decision: SwiGLU fails the predeclared early-quality gate: held-out gains are -6/245 and +4/493, with +32 execution failures versus gated GELU. Public scores are 108/960 versus 107/960. Keep gated GELU; no second-seed quality confirmation or long run is triggered. Faster short training is a useful observation, but this unequal-time test does not establish accuracy at matched compute. The retained mature best stays 575/960; current public rank is 10/16 at 22:47 (+03:00).
compute: Driver duration 447.17 seconds (7.45 minutes), including restoration, both arms and evaluation. Training-process times were 209.49 and 166.92 seconds. Logged training throughput was 1339.9 versus 1701.9 examples/s. Whole-driver GPU utilization averaged 69.58% (median 90%); peak memory 18681 MiB. Allocation, Drive sign-in and installation are outside driver timing.
